definitions.gloss: things seen and heard; experience; observations; knowledge gained firsthand
definitions.explanation: Knowledge and impressions acquired through direct personal observation, such as what one witnessed and learned during travel or fieldwork.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見聞|みき}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}した→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: I talked about what I saw and heard on the trip.

examples.japanese: {見聞|みき}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: I went abroad to broaden my horizons.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{見聞|みき}き⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧もと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: I compiled a report based on what I saw and heard on site.

notes:
Combines ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to see) and ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to hear) to refer to firsthand experience and knowledge gained through direct observation. As a noun, it means the things one has seen and heard; as a verb ({見聞|みき}き⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧), it means to see and hear, to observe directly.

USAGE:
- {見聞|みき}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧ is a very common expression meaning "to broaden one's experience/horizons"
- The kanji compound ⟦{見聞|けんぶん}→見聞：20127_kenbun⟧ is a more formal reading with the same meaning
- Often used when recounting travel experiences or field observations

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見聞|みき}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧: to broaden one's experience
- {見聞|みき}き⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧こと: things one has seen and heard
- {見聞|みき}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{深|ふか}める→深める：02407_fukameru⟧: to deepen one's knowledge through experience
- {見聞|みき}き{録|ろく}: a record of observations

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧: experience — broader, includes all types of experience
- ⟦{見聞|けんぶん}→見聞：20127_kenbun⟧: the on'yomi reading; more formal and literary
- ⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧: hands-on experience — emphasizes personal participation
